method_card.title: School Subjects and the School Day
method_card.content:
This lesson covers school subject vocabulary, telling the time in German, and giving reasoned opinions about your timetable using weil and obwohl.

GermanEnglish
die Mathematik / Mathemaths
die Naturwissenschaftscience
die Geschichtehistory
die Erdkundegeography
die Kunstart
der SportPE
die InformatikIT/computing
die Fremdspracheforeign language
Mein Lieblingsfachmy favourite subject
interessantinteresting
langweiligboring
nützlichuseful
schwer / schwierigdifficult
Es macht Spaß.It is fun.
die Note, -ngrade / mark

Grammar focus 1 — opinions with finden and weil: Say Ich finde + subject + adjective to give an opinion: Ich finde Mathe schwer. Add a reason with weil: after weil, the conjugated verb moves to the end of the clause. Example: Mein Lieblingsfach ist Musik, weil es Spaß macht.

Grammar focus 2 — telling the time: German uses a different logic from English. Halb means 'half to' the next hour, NOT 'half past'. So halb neun = 8:30 (half to nine). Viertel vor sieben = 6:45. Viertel nach sieben = 7:15. Drill these carefully — they are opposite to English intuition.
Time phrases force inversion: Montags habe ich Englisch. (verb second, subject after).

Model paragraph: Mein Lieblingsfach ist Musik, weil es kreativ und interessant ist. Ich finde Mathe schwer, obwohl ich gute Noten bekomme. Montags in der ersten Stunde habe ich Deutsch um Viertel nach acht.
(My favourite subject is Music because it is creative and interesting. I find Maths difficult, although I get good grades. On Mondays in the first period I have German at quarter past eight.)
steps: Learn school subject names with their genders (der Sport, die Mathematik, die Erdkunde)
Give opinions using finden + adjective and justify with weil + verb at the end of the clause
Master German time-telling: halb neun = 8:30, Viertel vor/nach — opposite of English logic
Describe your timetable using a time phrase + inversion (Montags habe ich...)
Build longer sentences combining opinions, reasons and timetable details

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — school life appears across all papers, including writing tasks and picture card conversation

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: 'Mein Lieblingsfach ist Deutsch, weil es nützlich ist.'

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Mein Lieblingsfach ist Deutsch = My favourite subject is German.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: weil = because. Notice the verb ist goes to the end of the clause after weil.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: es nützlich ist = it is useful (verb at end).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: My favourite subject is German because it is useful.

worked_examples.question: What does 'halb zehn' mean — and why is it NOT 9:30?

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: In German, halb means 'half to' the next hour. So halb zehn = half to ten = 9:30.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Halb zehn = 9:30. Halb acht = 7:30. Halb zwölf = 11:30. Always the hour BEFORE the one named.

worked_examples.question: How do you say 'On Tuesdays I have History in the second period'?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Start with the time phrase: Dienstags (on Tuesdays). This goes at position 1.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: The verb must be at position 2: habe. The subject follows: ich.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Add the subject and period: Geschichte in der zweiten Stunde.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Dienstags habe ich Geschichte in der zweiten Stunde. Never say 'Dienstags ich habe' — the verb must be second.

bronze.question: Match the German school subjects to the English meaning
Match the German opinion words to the English meaning
Complete the sentence with the correct form of finden

wrong.findet: findet is the er/sie form. For ich, use finde.
wrong.finden: finden is the infinitive or wir/sie plural form. For ich, use finde.

gaps.correct_explain: findet is the er/sie form of finden. The stem ends in -d, so an extra e is inserted.

wrong.finde: finde is the ich form. Schwester means she: use findet.

bronze.question: Complete the timetable sentence — remember the inversion rule

gaps.rule: Inversion — verb second after time phrase
gaps.correct_explain: When a time phrase (Montags in der ersten Stunde) starts the sentence, the verb comes second and the subject follows: habe ich.

wrong.hat: hat is the er/sie form. The subject is ich: use habe.
wrong.haben: haben is the wir/sie plural form. For ich, use habe.

bronze.question: What does 'Ich bin gut in Erdkunde' mean?

bronze.source_text: Mein Lieblingsfach ist Musik, weil es Spaß macht.
model_answers: My favourite subject is Music because it is fun.
hints: Spaß macht = is fun / makes fun

silver.question: Complete the sentence (no word bank)
silver.english: My favourite subject is Biology because it **is** scientific, although it is sometimes **difficult**.
sentence_parts: Mein Lieblingsfach ist Biologie, weil es wissenschaftlich

gaps.correct_explain: After weil, the verb goes to the end: weil es wissenschaftlich ist.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Mittwochs ich habe Sport in der dritten Stunde.
silver.explanation: When a time phrase (Mittwochs) starts the sentence, the verb must come second: Mittwochs habe ich Sport. The subject and verb swap places.
silver.translation: On Wednesdays I have PE in the third period.

silver.question: Build the sentence in German
silver.english: I like learning German because it is useful.

distractor_labels.nützlicher: wrong form — nützlicher is the comparative (more useful). The sentence just says 'useful': nützlich

silver.source_text: On Thursdays in the second period I have science. I find it interesting.
model_answers: Donnerstags in der zweiten Stunde habe ich Naturwissenschaft. Ich finde es interessant.
hints: second period = in der zweiten Stunde

gold.source_text: My favourite subject is Music because it is creative and fun. I find Maths difficult, although I get good grades. On Mondays I have French in the first period at quarter past eight.
model_answers: Mein Lieblingsfach ist Musik, weil es kreativ ist und Spaß macht. Ich finde Mathe schwer, obwohl ich gute Noten bekomme. Montags habe ich Französisch in der ersten Stunde um Viertel nach acht.

gold.question: Build the sentence in German
gold.english: I think that school uniform is important.

distractor_labels.weil: wrong conjunction — dass means 'that' (for opinions). weil means 'because' (for reasons).
distractor_labels.finde: both denke and finde can introduce a dass clause, but denke (I think) is more precise here than finde (I find/consider)

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: Your German exchange partner asks you about your school life, your timetable and your opinions on subjects.

bullets.prompt: Say what your favourite subject is and give a reason using weil.
bullets.model_answer: Mein Lieblingsfach ist Kunst, weil es kreativ ist und Spaß macht.
bullets.note: Lieblingsfach + ist + weil + verb at end

bullets.prompt: Describe your timetable on one day, including a time.
bullets.model_answer: Montags habe ich Mathe in der ersten Stunde um halb neun. Danach habe ich Englisch.
bullets.note: inversion after Montags, time-telling halb neun = 8:30, danach for sequence

bullets.prompt: Give your opinion on a subject you dislike and explain why using obwohl.
bullets.model_answer: Ich finde Sport anstrengend, obwohl ich weiß, dass es gesund ist. Ich bekomme schlechte Noten.
bullets.note: finden + adjective, obwohl + verb at end, dass + verb at end

gold.question: Write 40-50 words in German about your school subjects. Include: your favourite subject and why, a subject you dislike and why, your timetable on one day using a time, and whether you prefer German or British school life.
gold.ai_system_prompt: You are a GCSE German examiner marking extended writing about school subjects and the school day. Mark on: Communication (all bullet points addressed?), Range of language (finden, weil/obwohl + verb-final, time-telling, inversion after time phrase, comparatives), Accuracy (verb-second word order in main clauses, verb-final in subordinate clauses after weil/obwohl/dass, capitalisation of nouns, umlauts). Be encouraging and formative. Respond in JSON: {"quality":"excellent|good|needs_work|not_valid","feedback":"3-4 sentences covering each criterion","improvement":"One specific grammar point to work on"}

gold.audio_text: Mein Lieblingsfach ist Deutsch, weil es nützlich und interessant ist. Ich finde Mathe schwer, obwohl ich gute Noten bekomme.
gold.correct_text: Mein Lieblingsfach ist Deutsch, weil es nützlich und interessant ist. Ich finde Mathe schwer, obwohl ich gute Noten bekomme.
gold.translation: My favourite subject is German because it is useful and interesting. I find Maths difficult although I get good grades.

gold.source_text: In Germany pupils do not wear school uniform. I think that uniform is practical because everyone looks the same.
model_answers: In Deutschland trägt man keine Schuluniform. Ich denke, dass die Uniform praktisch ist, weil alle gleich aussehen.
